enonce.texte: Match the English job interview vocabulary with their French translations.

questions.reponse: interview = entretien, CV = curriculum vitae, experience = expérience, skills = compétences, qualifications = qualifications, salary = salaire, job offer = offre d'emploi, position = poste

enonce.texte:
Classify the following words as personal qualities or professional skills.

Words: punctual, computer skills, team player, communication, honest, problem-solving, responsible, leadership, hardworking, typing, English, adaptable

questions.reponse: Personal qualities: punctual, team player, honest, responsible, hardworking, adaptable; Professional skills: computer skills, communication, problem-solving, leadership, typing, English

enonce.texte:
Complete the following common interview questions with the correct word from the box.

Word box: do, where, why, tell, what, when, how, describe

questions.texte: _______ can you contribute to our company?
_______ did you decide to apply for this position?
_______ do you see yourself in five years?
_______ you have any questions for us?

intitule: Sample Interview Dialogue - Fill in the Blanks

enonce.texte:
Complete the interview dialogue with the correct words from the box.

Word box: experience, skills, position, application, company, qualifications, salary, career

Interviewer: Good morning! Thank you for coming. Please tell me why you are interested in this ________ (1).

Candidate: Good morning! I am very interested in working for your ________ (2) because it has a great reputation.

Interviewer: Can you tell me about your ________ (3) and ________ (4)?

Candidate: Yes. I have five years of ________ (5) in sales. I also have strong communication and teamwork ________ (6).

Interviewer: What are your ________ (7) goals?

Candidate: I want to grow in this company and build a successful ________ (8).

questions.reponse: 1. position, 2. company, 3. qualifications, 4. experience, 5. experience, 6. skills, 7. career, 8. career (Note: 3 and 4 can be swapped; 5 can be 'experience'; 7 and 8 can be 'career' or similar)

enonce.texte: Find and correct the grammar mistakes in the following interview questions and answers. There may be more than one mistake.

questions.texte: Why you want to work here?
questions.reponse: Why do you want to work here?

questions.texte: I am have two years of experience.
questions.reponse: I have two years of experience.

questions.texte: I can to work in a team.
questions.reponse: I can work in a team.

questions.texte: When did you started your last job?
questions.reponse: When did you start your last job?

enonce.texte:
Write a short self-introduction (5-7 sentences) that you would say at the beginning of a job interview. Include the following information:

  • Your name
  • Your professional background
  • Your education
  • Your key skills
  • Why you are interested in the position

questions.reponse: Good morning, my name is Marie Ngo. I have a degree in Business Administration from the University of Yaoundé. I have three years of experience working as an administrative assistant. My key skills include Microsoft Office, communication, and organization. I am very interested in this position because it offers an opportunity to grow in a dynamic company. I am a responsible and hardworking person. Thank you for this opportunity.

enonce.texte:
Work with a partner. One student is the interviewer, the other is the candidate. The interviewer must ask at least 5 questions from the list below. The candidate must answer with complete sentences. After the role-play, write the dialogue.

Interview Questions:

  • Could you introduce yourself?
  • Why do you want to work here?
  • What are your strengths?
  • What are your weaknesses?
  • Where do you see yourself in five years?
  • Why should we hire you?
  • Do you have any questions for us?

questions.reponse: Interviewer: Could you introduce yourself? Candidate: Good morning. My name is Jean. I have a degree in marketing and two years of experience. Interviewer: Why do you want to work here? Candidate: I like your company's reputation and I want to grow here. Interviewer: What are your strengths? Candidate: I am a good communicator and team player. Interviewer: What are your weaknesses? Candidate: Sometimes I am too perfectionist. Interviewer: Where do you see yourself in five years? Candidate: I want to become a team leader. Interviewer: Why should we hire you? Candidate: Because I am hardworking and motivated. Interviewer: Do you have any questions for us? Candidate: Yes. What is the work environment like? Interviewer: It is friendly and professional. Candidate: Thank you.

enonce.texte:
You are applying for a position as a Sales Assistant at a supermarket in Douala. The interviewer asks you the following questions. Write full, professional answers for each question.

Questions:

  1. Tell me about yourself.
  2. Why do you want to work here?
  3. What experience do you have in sales?
  4. What are your best qualities?
  5. How do you handle difficult customers?

questions.texte: Write your answers to the interview questions.
questions.reponse: 1. My name is Paul. I am 24 years old. I studied marketing and I am very friendly and sociable. 2. I want to work here because I like dealing with people and this supermarket has many customers. 3. I worked as a vendor at the market for two years. I learned to sell products and talk to customers. 4. My best qualities are honesty, punctuality, and patience. 5. I stay calm, listen to the customer's problem, and try to find a solution. I always try to be polite.
